candidate_matrix_revisions: Expand the feature contract from 12 ranks to source-backed price-volume, residual, trend-quality, regime and static LLM-compiled interaction factors.
Use five-trading-day training cross sections while preserving 21-day portfolio evaluation and labels.
Add LightGBM LambdaRank and explicit rule-model blends rather than treating point regression as the only ML role.
Select and de-correlate factors inside each training fold only, with core-only and missing-AI-factor controls.
Treat the historical tail as an exposed challenge set and reserve formal confirmation for frozen forward virtual paper.
objective: Test whether a source-backed AI factor library, cross-sectional ranking and bounded rule-model ensembles add stable value to the frozen deterministic stock-momentum baseline.

sources.core_claim: Nonlinear ML models find economically important interactions among momentum, liquidity and volatility characteristics in broad equity panels.
sources.project_applicability: Motivates expanded characteristic groups and strict linear-versus-tree ablation.
sources.reflection: The study has far broader data and a longer history than this frozen 40-stock universe.

sources.core_claim: Qlib provides reproducible Alpha158/Alpha360 feature and model workflows across linear and tree models.
sources.project_applicability: Supports a formula factor registry, model-family comparison and experiment records.
sources.reflection: Open Composer must retain its own PIT, cost, survivorship and forward-paper gates.

sources.core_claim: LambdaRank models grouped relevance observations directly instead of optimizing independent point forecasts.
sources.project_applicability: Supports a date-grouped stock-ranking challenger with group sizes defined by decision date.
sources.reflection: A ranking objective does not remove time leakage or small-regime-sample risk.

sources.core_claim: Momentum models can combine trend signals, volatility scaling and learned nonlinear temporal interactions.
sources.project_applicability: Motivates trend-quality, volatility and regime interactions without importing a deep network into a small dataset.
sources.reflection: Deep futures evidence does not directly validate cross-sectional US stock selection.

sources.core_claim: Formulaic factor discovery can be represented as bounded expression search with explicit operators and evaluation feedback.
sources.project_applicability: Motivates a static auditable formula proposal registry rather than opaque live LLM signals.
sources.reflection: Automated formula search creates severe multiple-testing risk without preregistration and fold-local selection.

sources.core_claim: Symbolic generation can seek diverse formulaic alphas while controlling expression structure.
sources.project_applicability: Motivates deduplicated interaction formulas and diversity checks across factor groups.
sources.reflection: Published benchmark gains may not survive modern costs or a small frozen universe.

sources.credibility: Microsoft Research preprint with open-source implementation
sources.core_claim: R&D-Agent(Q) separates research hypotheses, factor implementation and experiment feedback in an iterative loop.
sources.project_applicability: LLM acts as an offline research compiler with structured artifacts and hashes, not as a live signal oracle.
sources.reflection: Automated iteration still needs a hard candidate budget and exposed-holdout disclosure.

sources.core_claim: LLM alpha mining should be evaluated for robustness, efficiency, diversity and out-of-sample generalization.
sources.project_applicability: Requires factor redundancy checks, marginal lift, missing-factor fallback and explicit AI contribution status.
sources.reflection: Benchmark performance is not evidence for this data source or portfolio.

sources.core_claim: Risk-adjusted six- and twelve-month momentum plus turnover controls are mature deterministic inputs.
sources.project_applicability: Defines the strong deterministic feature and portfolio baseline ML must beat.
sources.reflection: Index methodology does not prove alpha for the selected current universe.

sources.core_claim: Momentum losses can cluster in stressed reversal regimes.
sources.project_applicability: Motivates regime, drawdown and uncertainty factors and a model abstention role.
sources.reflection: Long-short crash evidence may overstate the hedge need for a long-only strategy.
